definitions.explanation: A country that is still in the process of industrialization and economic growth. A shortened form of 発展途上国.

examples.japanese: {途上国|とじょうこく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Support for developing countries is needed.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{途上国|とじょうこく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧な⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many developing countries lack access to clean water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{途上国|とじょうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}める→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧だ。
examples.english: Narrowing the economic gap between developed and developing countries is a challenge for the international community.

notes:
An abbreviation of ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧{途上国|とじょうこく} (developing country). The full form literally means "country on the path of development" — {途上|とじょう} means "on the way" and {国|こく} means "country."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {途上国|とじょうこく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧ (aid to developing countries)
- {途上国|とじょうこく}⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧ (support for developing countries)
- ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{途上国|とじょうこく} (developed and developing countries)
- {途上国|とじょうこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (development of developing countries)

The shortened form {途上国|とじょうこく} is more common in everyday news and conversation than the full form ⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧{途上国|とじょうこく}. The opposite is ⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧ (developed country).
